name: stats-strip
description: Horizontal band of big-number statistics — value + label per stat. Static (no counter animation), works without JS. Replaces v1 stats-strip which had broken IntersectionObserver-driven counters.

ai.whenToUse: Use to surface 3–5 quantitative trust signals (active users, uptime, countries, NPS, years in business). Best placed just above or below the hero, or between features and pricing.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't fabricate numbers. Don't pad — three real stats beat five inflated ones.

stats.description: Stat tiles. Each has a `value` (the big number/string), a `label` (what it measures), and optional `accent: true` to highlight the most important stat.
